data.narrative: The student successfully designed, implemented, verified, and debugged the Async Background Jobs & Analytics layer for the URL shortener API. They introduced an asynchronous BackgroundTasks execution queue on the GET /r/{code} hot path to keep public redirects sub-millisecond, implemented ClickEvent database storage with unique click_id idempotency keys to prevent duplicate click counting on retries, enforced SHA-256 IP hashing for privacy compliance, exposed protected analytics querying endpoints (GET /links/{id}/analytics), and provided administrative data retention purging (DELETE /links/analytics/purge).

dimension_scores.observation: Selected Option B (async background analytics queue) to decouple click logging from the public redirect path and preserve sub-millisecond response latency.
dimension_scores.evidence: Chose Option B in DECIDE step and recorded decision in state.json.

dimension_scores.observation: Executed hypothesis-driven debugging during BREAK drill, demonstrating duplicate click risk when idempotency pre-checks are omitted, and verifying 100% fix resolution.
dimension_scores.evidence: Commented out click_id pre-check to reproduce duplicate assertion error, restored function, and verified clean pass in scripts/module-07-verify-jobs.py.

dimension_scores.observation: Enforced SHA-256 IP hashing (ip_hash) to guarantee raw client IP addresses are never saved to disk (GDPR compliance), and protected analytics query/purge endpoints with administrative API key auth.
Built fail-open background task handlers so analytics queue/database errors never block or slow down public redirect HTTP 307 responses, and implemented retention purging to prevent table bloat.
dimension_scores.evidence: Verified fail-open task execution and retention purge endpoint.
